About

I like building the whole product.

For me, the model is only one part of the job. I enjoy working on the data, backend, evaluation and interface so the final product is actually useful.

I’m a final year Computer Science & Engineering student at Islamic University of Technology and currently an Applied AI Intern at Battery Low Interactive. I mainly work with machine learning, generative AI, data systems and full stack development.

I’ve worked on RAG systems, LLM apps, forecasting, REST APIs and MERN projects. I enjoy taking an idea from the model or backend all the way to something people can actually use.

I’m looking for internships and junior roles where I can work on real AI products, learn from experienced engineers and keep improving as a software and AI engineer.

RAG and demand forecasting for smarter restocking decisions.

Built a system that combines policy documents with demand forecasts to support restocking decisions. FastAPI connects ChromaDB retrieval, Prophet forecasting and a Hugging Face model with a Streamlit interface.

Kothay

Traffic forecasting for Dhaka routes and travel planning.

Built a forecasting system using TomTom traffic data for 20 major Dhaka routes in both directions. Prophet and seasonal ARIMA are compared using MAE, with results shown in a Streamlit and Folium dashboard.

Signal: 40 route-directions
